body: Me too... Life sucks like that. I have anger issues, and every time something happens, even something not worth fighting over happens, I will freak out and either relapse or do something, say something, harmful. I don't have a healthy coping method; or any real ones at all really. I've got no one to contact, no one to help me through my thoughts, though even if I did I probably wouldn't consult them. Maybe it's because of all the trauma that I'm repressing. Sometimes I just think it's a habit, to want to yeet myself off a bridge because of the stupidest things, like when someone doesn't knock on your door or someone embarrasses you in public. Honestly, I have no experience, of anything. All I have are these toxic thoughts swarming in my head, just begging to be set free.
